test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**and**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We need to use the conjunction in the given sentence to link two clauses of a sentence.
 
• The conjunction "**and**" is a **coordinating conjunction.**
 
• We use "and" to show one action follows another in a chronology
